newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Vienna circus bear runs amok, bites bottom.
newsitem.headline: Vienna circus bear runs amok, bites bottom.

text.p: A circus bear ran amok in the streets of Vienna on Wednesday, biting three people before being cornered and sedated after his one-hour AWOL.

The eight-year-old male brown bear, who broke free during unloading at the "Golden Globe" circus in the southern district of Liesing, rampaged through a housing estate and bit one hapless passer-by on the bottom, the police said.
An animal keeper and a security guard were the bear's other victims. They got away with nips on the thigh.
Authorities ordered the bear to be held in quarantine to determine whether it was diseased.
